definition: Adolescent psychotherapy is psychotherapy for young people in their teenage years, used to address mental health problems that often begin early in life. In this setting, building engagement and a good therapist-client relationship can be especially difficult because adolescents may be balancing a need for autonomy with needing help, and some begin therapy at other people’s urging rather than their own.
